description: Each fixture comment follows the pattern: (MIME structure + keywords), (mailbox), dash, 'exercises' (feature list). This is not decoration — it serves as a lookup index for anyone writing a new test who needs to find an existing fixture covering a given feature. 16 fixtures cover distinct feature intersections; without this index a contributor has to read each fixture's construction code to understand its purpose. The consistent structure also makes it easy to scan for gaps (e.g., 'which fixture exercises header:name:all?'). A contributor might suggest removing the comments as redundant with the fixture names, but the names are short identifiers (email-6: multi-mailbox) while the comments state the specific fields and behaviors exercised, which the name alone cannot convey. The comments should be kept and the three-part structure should be enforced for any new fixtures added.
title: Seed fixture comments follow consistent three-part structure: content / placement / what-it-exercises
